services.name: lm-studio
entrypoint: apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates libatomic1 libgomp1 procps && if [ ! -f /usr/local/bin/lms ]; then curl -fsSL https://lmstudio.ai/install.sh | bash && ln -s /root/.lmstudio/bin/lms /usr/local/bin/lms; fi && lms daemon up && lms link enable || true && lms server start --port 1234 --bind 0.0.0.0 --cors || true && if [ -n "$MODEL_ID" ]; then lms get "$MODEL_ID" --yes || true; lms load "$MODEL_ID" --context-length "${CONTEXT_LENGTH:-8192}" --identifier "$MODEL_ID" -y || true; fi && tail -f /dev/null
